thread:
emma: Noticed unexpected egress bill spike for apac-gpu-edge this billing cycle. Digging in, seems dedicated tenants with heavy KV traffic are amplifying SNAT usage via short connects.
rajesh: checking flow logs: a couple tenants (gamma-ops, delta-ai) have huge outbound new_conn rates to kv-store replicas in apac1. They are on dedicated pools that route via shared nat-gw-apac.
olga: This smells like noisy neighbor again. Two paths: 1) move those tenants to private nat-gw per-dedicated-pool (costly) 2) enforce per-tenant connection pooling and rate limits.
infra-bot: ALERT: egress-cost-anomaly-apac - projected +32% on egress processing fees due to increased SNAT churn.
oncall: For immediate relief we can flip routing to nat-gw-apac-2 (standby) but that doesn't fix churn.
product-eng: We need to contact the tenants (SEs) and ask them to enable keepalives. Also consider SDK shipped changes to reuse HTTP/2 or gRPC channels across calls.
rajesh: Also we could implement a small L4 proxy on the node that multiplexes outbound TLS connections per destination to cut down 4-tuple churn. Might be a middle ground.
emma: Agree. Please add to the incident checklists: cost estimate for per-tenant proxies vs NAT scaling, and a request template to contact tenant engineering to adopt pooling.
olga: Creating a JIRA: PROJ-8934 "apac egress cost spike - noisy tenants" and a runbook.
infra-bot: ACTION_CREATED: change-request #4810 - route gamma-ops, delta-ai -> nat-gw-apac-2 temporary.
oncall: applied. SNAT usage dropped from 97% -> 51%. Watching billing metrics.
product-eng: We should also consider per-tenant billing signals so customers see cost impact of inefficient patterns. Might drive good behavior.
emma: Long-term roadmap item: SDK keepalive v2 + outbound multiplexer. Add to Q2 roadmap.
rajesh: Also check kernel conntrack settings on apac edge nodes; some were near limit. Patching to increase bucket and conntrack_max temporarily.
infra-bot: RESOLVED egress-cost-anomaly-apac - routing change lowered SNAT usage; follow-ups created.
oncall: Will add escalation rule: if nat-gw SNAT > 95% for >10m, page infra-pager and auto-create change-request.
product-eng: I'll draft a tenant notification template and coordinate with SEs.
emma: thanks all. Please put final cost delta in the JIRA and cross-link to product roadmap ticket.
